objective: 验证终局状态门禁，使用当前内容质量门禁重新生成 B3 三样本报告，以三次重复 Judge 形成真实多数，并冻结不含预填标签的新人工标注包。

pipeline: current Planner, frozen Retriever and LLM Reader
finding substance gate and citation validation
LLM Synthesizer, RedTeam, Blue revision and Verifier
three repeated Judge v2 calls with majority aggregation
independent blank A/B packets plus disagreement-only adjudication generation
Replay 2.0, manifest 1.1 and separate LLM traces

components.name: Terminal status gate
components.implementation: Preserves an explicit needs_revision/fail outcome when actionable findings are empty because of protocol inconsistency, while still allowing low-risk advisories and deterministically suppressed false findings.
components.notes: Covered by an end-to-end Pipeline/Replay/manifest integration test and one bounded live regression.

components.name: Current B3 report generation
components.implementation: Regenerates all three frozen benchmark reports through the current content and citation quality gates.
components.notes: Twenty-five complete report claims replaced the old title and truncated-fragment pilot claims.

components.name: Three-repeat Judge v2
components.implementation: Runs one Judge profile three times with deterministic claim-order seeds; 2:1 labels use majority and a complete split uses the conservative tie rule.
components.notes: Nine Judge calls completed with zero fallback.

components.name: Human annotation handoff
components.implementation: Freezes separate unlabeled A/B packets and generates self-contained local HTML forms; a post-annotation tool creates a blank third-human packet containing only A/B disagreements.
components.notes: Automatic and old human labels are intentionally absent.

protocol.notes: Automatic Judge results are engineering diagnostics and cannot authorize B4 without returned human labels.

metric_definitions.name: three_judge_label_agreement
metric_definitions.definition: Pairwise exact label agreement across three Judge repetitions for aligned report or gold claims.

metric_definitions.name: automatic_claim_metrics
metric_definitions.definition: Evidence-grounded Judge metrics before human calibration; these are not accuracy against a gold reference.
metric_definitions.limitations: Cannot be interpreted as calibrated precision or recall until independent labels return.

metric_definitions.name: content_gate_invalid_finding_count
metric_definitions.definition: Final key findings classified as title-only, author-only, truncated, or non-propositional by the content gate.

metric_definitions.name: pipeline_resource_usage
metric_definitions.definition: Generation and Judge call counts, token usage and per-report Pipeline latency.

observations: Current reports replace the old pilot's bibliographic and truncated extraction fragments with complete propositions.
bench_002 reliably refuses to claim DeepResearchAgent-specific coverage without system-specific frozen evidence.
Three repetitions create meaningful 2:1 majority decisions, but bench_002 gold agreement of 0.333 shows that repetition alone does not solve semantic calibration.
All automatic quality scores remain provisional until independently produced human labels are returned.

changed_variables: reports regenerated with current quality gate
Judge repetitions increased from two to three
comparison.notes: Benchmark claims and snapshots are unchanged, but regenerated reports and changed repetition count prevent direct metric comparison with the old human packet.

limitations: Human calibration is intentionally incomplete until two independent annotators return the new files.
The benchmark remains a three-sample draft engineering pilot and is not a released expert gold set.
Only one Judge model/profile is repeated; three calls measure sampling stability, not cross-model robustness.
bench_002 frozen sources do not contain DeepResearchAgent-specific definitions, so its quality_unresolved outcome reflects source coverage rather than a generation crash.
Automatic mean quality scores are model judgments and must not be presented as calibrated human accuracy.
next_actions: Have annotators A and B independently complete the new HTML forms without viewing old or automatic labels.
If any label differs, generate a disagreement-only adjudication handoff and obtain a third human decision.
Run calibration against the three-Judge aggregate and enforce the existing 0.75 macro precision/recall thresholds.
Keep B4 blocked unless both reference provenance and calibrated automatic metrics pass.
